author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a large open lens (r14) at the top-left with a short straight handle to the bottom-right corner, in line with the lens centre, matching the reference's large lens. An r12 candidate passed but had a smaller lens and longer handle than the reference; a three-arc r14 lens bulged 0.0015 past the keyshape and was rebuilt from quarter arcs. The rejected drawing had a small heavy lens and a long handle.
drawing_plan: Lens r14 about (20,20) from quarter arcs through (6,20),(20,6),(34,20),(20,34), lower-right quarter split at (30,30); handle (30,30)-(42,42).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'search': circle lens with a straight diagonal handle.
